description: This is a shell script file containing test routines and setup procedures for testing pseudo-merge bitmap functionality within a Git project. It defines multiple tests that validate the behavior of pseudo-merge groups, bitmap traversal, threshold configurations, pattern matching, overlap detection, reuse logic, and boundary traversal. The file employs test-lib.sh as a dependency and uses various Git commands to manipulate repositories and verify expected behaviors.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges
methods.description: Runs the command to dump pseudo-merge information and verifies the pseudo-merge groups.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merge_commits
methods.description: Outputs commits involved in a specific pseudo-merge group for comparison.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_satisfied
methods.description: Checks whether pseudo-merge satisfiability conditions are met based on trace data.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_cascades
methods.description: Verifies cascade relationships in pseudo-merge groups from trace data.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_reused
methods.description: Checks for reuse of pseudo-merge bitmaps in the repository.

methods.name: tag_everything
methods.description: Creates tags for all commits in the repository.
